posts.title: On severe anxiety
posts.description: This post talks about severe mental health issues, anxiety, and death. There’s no great revelation in here, and it’s the same concept a lot of professionals would try to hammer home, but it took a specific way of thinking about this for me to feel relief, so maybe it’ll help someone else. posts.title: Introducing supporter features for Scrandle
